# Appendix: R Code

## Libraries and Data

```{r load-libraries}
library(mlogit)
library(dfidx)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(modelsummary)
library(writexl)
```

```{r load-data}
# Load the dataset
student_data <- read.csv("data 3.csv", sep = ";")
```

```{r missing-data}
# Check for missing values across all columns
colSums(is.na(student_data))
```

```{r descriptive-statistics}
# Descriptive statistics for all explanatory variables
summary(student_data[, c("Debtor", "Tuition.fees.up.to.date", 
                          "Scholarship.holder", "Admission.grade",
                          "Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade.",
                          "Age.at.enrollment", "Gender", 
                          "Unemployment.rate")])
```

## Data Transformations

```{r recode-target}
# Convert Target to factor with Graduate as reference category
student_data$Target <- as.character(student_data$Target)

student_data$Target <- factor(student_data$Target,
                               levels = c("Graduate", "Dropout", "Enrolled"))

levels(student_data$Target)
table(student_data$Target)
```

```{r reshape-mlogit}
# Reshape data into long format required by mlogit
student_mlogit <- dfidx(student_data,
                        choice = "Target",
                        shape = "wide")
```

## Model Estimation

```{r general-model}
# General unrestricted model with 14 variables
general_model <- mlogit(Target ~ 1 | Debtor + Tuition.fees.up.to.date +
                          Scholarship.holder + Admission.grade +
                          Previous.qualification..grade. +
                          Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                          Age.at.enrollment + Gender + Displaced +
                          Daytime.evening.attendance. +
                          Mother.s.qualification + Unemployment.rate +
                          Inflation.rate + GDP,
                          data = student_mlogit,
                          reflevel = "Graduate")

summary(general_model)
```

```{r intermediate-model}
# Intermediate model after removing 5 insignificant variables
intermediate_model <- mlogit(Target ~ 1 | Debtor + Tuition.fees.up.to.date +
                          Scholarship.holder + Admission.grade +
                          Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                          Age.at.enrollment + Gender +
                          Mother.s.qualification + Unemployment.rate,
                          data = student_mlogit,
                          reflevel = "Graduate")

summary(intermediate_model)
```

```{r final-model}
# Final specific model after removing Mother.s.qualification
final_model <- mlogit(Target ~ 1 | Debtor + Tuition.fees.up.to.date +
                          Scholarship.holder + Admission.grade +
                          Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                          Age.at.enrollment + Gender +
                          Unemployment.rate,
                          data = student_mlogit,
                          reflevel = "Graduate")

summary(final_model)
```

## Interaction Terms

```{r first-interaction}
# First attempt: Debtor:Tuition and Scholarship:Admission interactions
first_int <- mlogit(Target ~ 1 | Debtor + Tuition.fees.up.to.date +
                          Scholarship.holder + Admission.grade +
                          Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                          Age.at.enrollment + Gender +
                          Unemployment.rate +
                          Debtor:Tuition.fees.up.to.date +
                          Scholarship.holder:Admission.grade,
                          data = student_mlogit,
                          reflevel = "Graduate")

summary(first_int)
```

```{r mean-centering}
# Mean-centering to address multicollinearity in interaction terms
student_data$Debtor_c <- scale(student_data$Debtor, scale = FALSE)
student_data$Tuition_c <- scale(student_data$Tuition.fees.up.to.date, scale = FALSE)
student_data$Scholarship_c <- scale(student_data$Scholarship.holder, scale = FALSE)
student_data$Admission_c <- scale(student_data$Admission.grade, scale = FALSE)

student_mlogit_c <- dfidx(student_data,
                           choice = "Target",
                           shape = "wide")

centered_int <- mlogit(Target ~ 1 | Debtor_c + Tuition_c +
                          Scholarship_c + Admission_c +
                          Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                          Age.at.enrollment + Gender +
                          Unemployment.rate +
                          Debtor_c:Tuition_c +
                          Scholarship_c:Admission_c,
                          data = student_mlogit_c,
                          reflevel = "Graduate")

summary(centered_int)
```

```{r final-model-interaction}
# Final model with Gender:Debtor interaction
final_model_int <- mlogit(Target ~ 1 | Debtor + Tuition.fees.up.to.date +
                          Scholarship.holder + Admission.grade +
                          Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                          Age.at.enrollment + Gender +
                          Unemployment.rate +
                          Gender:Debtor,
                          data = student_mlogit,
                          reflevel = "Graduate")

summary(final_model_int)
```

## Average Marginal Effects

```{r marginal-effects}
# Average marginal effects for all variables in the final model
vars <- c("Debtor", "Tuition.fees.up.to.date", "Scholarship.holder", 
          "Admission.grade", "Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade.", 
          "Age.at.enrollment", "Gender", "Unemployment.rate")

for(v in vars) {
  cat("\n---", v, "---\n")
  print(round(apply(effects(final_model_int, covariate = v, 
                            data = student_mlogit), 2, mean), 4))
}
```

## Publication Quality Table

```{r}

# Get estimates for each model
general_est <- get_estimates(general_model)
intermediate_est <- get_estimates(intermediate_model)
final_est <- get_estimates(final_model_int)

# Add significance stars
add_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.01, "***", ifelse(p < 0.05, "**", ifelse(p < 0.1, "*", "")))
}

# Create coefficient + stars + se columns for each model
format_model <- function(est, model_name) {
  est$coef_stars <- paste0(round(est$estimate, 4), add_stars(est$p.value))
  est$se_formatted <- paste0("(", round(est$std.error, 4), ")")
  est[, c("term", "coef_stars", "se_formatted")]
}

general_fmt <- format_model(general_est, "General")
intermediate_fmt <- format_model(intermediate_est, "Intermediate")
final_fmt <- format_model(final_est, "Final")

# Merge all models side by side
all_terms <- unique(c(general_fmt$term, intermediate_fmt$term, final_fmt$term))

wide_table <- data.frame(term = all_terms)
wide_table <- merge(wide_table, general_fmt, by = "term", all.x = TRUE)
wide_table <- merge(wide_table, intermediate_fmt, by = "term", all.x = TRUE, 
                    suffixes = c("_general", "_intermediate"))
wide_table <- merge(wide_table, final_fmt, by = "term", all.x = TRUE)
wide_table[is.na(wide_table)] <- ""

colnames(wide_table) <- c("Term", "General Coef", "General SE", 
                           "Intermediate Coef", "Intermediate SE",
                           "Final Coef", "Final SE")

write_xlsx(wide_table, "publication_table_wide.xlsx")
```

## Diagnostic Tests

```{r linktest}
# Extract fitted probabilities for linktest
predicted_matrix <- fitted(final_model_int, outcome = FALSE)

yhat <- predicted_matrix
yhat2 <- predicted_matrix^2

# Linktest for Dropout equation
linktest_dropout <- glm(as.numeric(student_data$Target == "Dropout") ~ 
                          yhat[,"Dropout"] + yhat2[,"Dropout"],
                          family = binomial)
summary(linktest_dropout)

# Linktest for Enrolled equation
linktest_enrolled <- glm(as.numeric(student_data$Target == "Enrolled") ~ 
                          yhat[,"Enrolled"] + yhat2[,"Enrolled"],
                          family = binomial)
summary(linktest_enrolled)
```

```{r vif}
# Variance Inflation Factor to check for multicollinearity
vif_model <- lm(as.numeric(student_data$Target) ~ Debtor + 
                Tuition.fees.up.to.date + Scholarship.holder + 
                Admission.grade + Curricular.units.2nd.sem..grade. +
                Age.at.enrollment + Gender + Unemployment.rate,
                data = student_data)

vif(vif_model)
```

```{r classification}
# Classification accuracy of the final model
predicted_class <- colnames(predicted_matrix)[apply(predicted_matrix, 
                                                     1, which.max)]
actual_class <- as.character(student_data$Target)

accuracy <- mean(predicted_class == actual_class)
cat("Classification Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 4))

table(Predicted = predicted_class, Actual = actual_class)
```

```{r confusion-matrix-plot}
# Confusion matrix heatmap
confusion_df <- as.data.frame(table(Predicted = predicted_class, 
                                     Actual = actual_class))

ggplot(confusion_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2C7BB6") +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix of Predicted vs Actual Student Outcomes",
       x = "Actual Outcome",
       y = "Predicted Outcome",
       fill = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
